name: mira-bridge
description: Expose a paired Windows computer as a remote native tool runtime for an Agent reasoning on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Run native Windows tools from a Mac-hosted Agent.
interface.longDescription: MiraBridge exposes a paired Windows computer as a deterministic remote tool runtime. Reasoning stays on macOS; Windows only executes structured operations and returns evidence.
defaultPrompt: Describe my paired Windows node and its available toolchain.
Run this project's tests on my Windows computer.
Inspect a Windows workspace without changing Mac-local files.
